items.q: What types of electronics do you remove?
a: We remove all electronics, including computers, TVs, printers, servers, phones, and office equipment, both home and business devices.

items.q: How do you properly dispose of old electronics?
a: All electronics are processed at certified recycling facilities that meet Ontario environmental standards, with data-containing devices securely wiped or destroyed.

items.q: How much does electronics removal cost?
a: Prices start at $125, depending on quantity and type. We offer free estimates by phone/text with no obligation.

items.q: What areas do you serve for electronics removal?
a: We serve Brampton, Caledon, East Gwillimbury, Etobicoke, Georgina, and all Greater Toronto Area communities.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day electronics pickup?
a: Yes, Same-day pickup is often available when you call.
